exposure: Implementation of the CARE (CAesarean REduction) strategy
cohort: Low-risk pregnant women at Markham Stouffville Hospital, Toronto, ON, Canada, compared to women at 36 control hospitals in the same province
finding: Implementation of the CARE strategy at Markham Stouffville Hospital was associated with a reduction in CD rates among low-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: This study found that a hospital-based program (CARE) successfully reduced cesarean delivery rates among low-risk pregnancies.
